answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a per-identity stake bond slashed on proven double-spend. Each agent locks a fixed minimum before its attestations count, and the bond scales with attestations per epoch, so N cheap identities cost N times that minimum plus the epoch burn. One audit surfacing a duplicate or contradictory claim forfeits the entire bond and freezes the identity, while honest agents lose only an echo of yield, never principal. Every false name is a paid voyage toward a walnut-hard exit: cost grows linearly with scale, gain does not.
